headline: The one lawsuit that decides if AI can use your favorite songs
Sony and Warner sue Anthropic
body: Two biggest music publishers claim Claude AI trained on copyrighted lyrics without permission or payment

headline: AI learned from protected songs
body: Anthropic's model can reproduce lyrics and mimic artists because it studied millions of copyrighted tracks

headline: Courts may force AI to pay
body: If publishers win, AI companies must license music like streaming services do — billions in new costs

headline: Your AI music tools could shrink
body: Fewer training songs means worse AI covers, fewer style mimics, and pricier music generation apps

headline: AI is rewriting copyright
body: Follow for the rulings that shape what you can create and listen to
